2609.19551.title: Continual Enterprise World Model Discovery in Dynamic Systems
2609.19551.paper_summary: In an enterprise system, updating one field can set another, create a record, or start an approval. These effects are produced by business rules that are not built into the platform but written by each organization and revised over time. An agent working in such a system cannot predict the result of its own actions without knowing these rules. We study continual enterprise world model discovery, where an agent starts without knowledge of these business rules and discovers them by interacting with records and observing the outcomes. From those observations it builds a world model, which it revises as the rules change. To evaluate this, we introduce EnterpriseWorldShift, built on a live ServiceNow environment with nine tables, 25 hidden rules and 600 evaluation actions. It presents four versions of the same enterprise world, with the tables and records held fixed while a rule is modified, then added, then removed, so that discovery, revision, extension and retirement are each tested in turn. Our Continual Discovery Agent (CDA) builds such a model and carries it from one world to the next. It predicts the effects of the hidden rules more accurately than looking them up for each question, the approach taken by prior work, by up to 8.98 IoU points, and it answers from its own model without querying the running system.
2609.19551.paper_summary_zh: 在企業系統中，更新一個欄位可以設定另一個欄位、創建一條記錄或啟動一個批准。這些效果是由商業規則產生的，這些規則並不是內建於平台中，而是由每個組織編寫並隨著時間進行修訂的。在這樣的系統中工作的代理無法預測自己行動的結果，除非了解這些規則。我們研究持續的企業世界模型發現，其中一個代理在沒有這些商業規則的知識的情況下開始，並通過與記錄互動和觀察結果來發現這些規則。從這些觀察中，它建立了一個世界模型，並在規則變更時進行修訂。為了評估這一點，我們引入了EnterpriseWorldShift，這是在一個活躍的ServiceNow環境中構建的，擁有九個表格、25條隱藏規則和600個評估行動。它呈現了同一企業世界的四個版本，當一條規則被修改、然後添加、再然後移除時，表格和記錄保持固定，這樣發現、修訂、擴展和退休依次進行測試。我們的持續發現代理（CDA）建立了這樣的模型，並將其從一個世界帶到下一個世界。它比起以往的工作中每次查詢隱藏規則的方式，準確地預測隱藏規則的效果高達8.98 IoU點，並且它從自己的模型中回答問題，而不需要查詢運行中的系統。
